You have to generate oauth token first. Follow this http://www.aschroder.com/2012/04/introduction-to-the-magento-rest-apis-with-oauth-in-version-1-7/ then test http://www.magentocommerce.com/api/rest/testing_rest_resources.html

If you dont want authentication you can use curl to get desired data. http://snipplr.com/view/44760/

In url pass valid magento resource url like www.yourwebsite.com/api/rest/products

Q: What to use when moving from static json files ( Javascript ) to database in FrontEnd A:

As already mentioned, it's unclear why you would need PHP here, if you already have python. I don't know if you've reached a misunderstanding just based on the ubiquity of PHP-based examples which exist out there, or something like that. But python/flask is more than capable of querying a database and returning the results to the front-end, and of receiving requests from that front-end and processing them. It performs exactly the same role in a web application stack that PHP would (or Java would, or ASP.NET/C# would, or NodeJS would, etc. etc. etc.)

So, whatever is currently fetching and returning the content of the JSON files just needs to be replaced with code which fetches and returns the same content, but from a database. If the frontend is already calling a backend method which loads and returns the files, you might not even need to change anything in the frontend at all - just replace the code in the backend function.
